data.title: First payment reminder from TechMarkt Online – €94.99
data.summary: TechMarkt Online GmbH sent a first reminder (1. Mahnung) dated 10 September 2026 for unpaid invoice TM-2026-0048213. The total of €94.99 (€89.99 plus a €5.00 reminder fee) is to be paid by 30 September 2026.
data.explanation: The retailer says it has not received payment for an invoice that was due on 3 September 2026. It now asks for €94.99, which includes a €5.00 reminder fee, by 30 September 2026. If you already paid, you can treat the letter as void. If not, pay soon, because the deadline is very close. Otherwise the claim may go to a debt collection company, which adds costs. If you think the claim is wrong, contact the company in writing. Check the IBAN and details before paying.
